about: Fiorentino Legal works from Furnace Brook Parkway in Quincy and publishes both injury and criminal defence work, with a contingency fee, a free consultation and a 24 hour line.
Its Google listing averages a flat five stars across 117 reviews. It names no attorney on the pages we could reach, which is the gate G5 asks about.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours, photo count and description come from the Places API. The services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Massachusetts does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Massachusetts does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile. Massachusetts publishes no business register we can query. The Secretary of the Commonwealth's corporate search answers a request for its robots file with a 403 and its search page with a redirect loop, and the state runs no open data portal carrying the register. This is a limit of the published record and not something the firm can change.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, no attorney is named on the site we could read. The gate also asks for no misleading claims, which is an editorial read we have not recorded.

G6.evidence: 117 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2018-11-24, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP
